HeurtebiseEtAl2026LiMVAM and GhoshalHonorio2018LinearSEM: both use recursive residual/Schur ideas, but neither states the compatible-order removed-set DAG.
HeurtebiseEtAl2026LiMVAM: its bivariate diversity condition is the closest published directional calculation.
HauserBuhlmann2014ActiveLearning and LindgrenEtAl2018CostAware concern interventional separating designs, not passive residual-witness tuple preservation.
HeurtebiseEtAl2026LiMVAM identifies a full-pair partial order under diversity; the proposed common-ancestry summary is a natural partial-calibration extension.

novelty_flags.one_line: The flagship aspirant names HeurtebiseEtAl2026LiMVAM but supplies no theorem, section, equation, or quoted open-problem locator for the claimed full-pair-to-partial-pair gap.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1 / related work
novelty_flags.one_line: Add Shimizu et al.'s DirectLiNGAM recursive-residual result as a plausible third methodological comparator; it is materially closer to the proposed root recursion than the current intervention-design comparators.

soundness_flags.label: ass:feasibility-separation and ass:path-product-separation
soundness_flags.one_line: GhoshalHonorio2018LinearSEM uses precision-diagonal and nonzero-precision-entry finite-sample gaps, not the proposal's wrong-order residual separation or common-ancestral path-product margins; retag these as novel margins and justify them.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 4, Assumption 1, Eq. (4); p. 6, Assumption 2, conditions (i)--(iii)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The cited paper's recursive finite-sample conditions are gaps between terminal/non-terminal precision quantities and a lower bound on nonzero precision entries over reduced graphs; it does not define the proposal's residual wrong-order or ancestral path-product margins.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v4, 31 Aug 2026; accepted ICML 2026 author version, proceedings text not publicly inspected
source_verification_receipts.locator: §3, Eq. (3) and model assumptions; §4.6, Assumptions 2--3 and Theorem 3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The available author version specifies a shared order, within-view independent disturbance components, cross-view correlation/diversity, and identifies coefficients and a partial ordering under Assumption 2; a total order additionally uses dense connectivity.
The article develops sample-criterion inversion for identified-set estimators, confidence regions, consistency, and rates; it does not provide LiMVAM branch-stability results.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Retag the two bespoke margins as novel, state why they are empirically meaningful away-from-strata conditions, and derive an explicit local covariance-to-margin stability modulus rather than presenting them as Ghoshal--Honorio standard assumptions.

Anchor the main claim to Heurtebise et al. §4.6 Assumption 2 and Theorem 3, then add a worked strictness example where full pairing is singleton but a proper calibration subset has multiple numerical tuples.
Add DirectLiNGAM as the recursive-residual comparator and state precisely which path-independence or complete-compatible-order step is absent there and in Heurtebise et al.

recommended_next_step: Revise the literature anchors and margin-assumption tags, then continue this field-tier partial-calibration angle to Stage 0.
